title: CSP-EN-301 detailed lab example
description: Explicit synthetic operating, specimen and reporting declarations. Prepared coated panels are supplied by the customer; coating application is not declared. Separate topcoat reporting remains unrecorded; post-cycle gloss retention is explicitly unavailable.
authoring_status: Source-authored synthetic development fixture after earlier diagnostics, frozen before final matching retake. It is not independent validation gold.
source_basis: CSP-EN-301 Section 2: prepared steel witness material, geometry and repeatable measurement map.
Section 3: before/after-cycle assessment, cycle settings and native ISO class reporting.
Sections 4-5: initial mean gloss and unavailable post-cycle retention; master-panel colour and panel-level records.
Total thickness is declared; separate topcoat capability deliberately remains absent.
limitations: 35-fact selected matching reference remains separate and unchanged.
This profile is optional user input; it must not overwrite an existing lab automatically.
Lab capacities are explicitly fictional choices, not claims inferred from a method identifier.
Unspecified coating application, configurations, quantities, source ambiguities and other absent details still require review.
